interpretation: Full persistent search is associated with a clear territory and income lead by its twelfth own turn on these exact replayed trajectories, without shortening median game length. The 25-percent exact-teacher mixture improved complete-game wins but has zero median lead in all four coarse features at that checkpoint. Therefore a simple early economic or territory snapshot is not a sufficient explanation for why partial teacher coverage helps, and the full-teacher territory difference is not by itself a valid student target. Checkpoint survival and the visited states are consequences of the policies; their paired distributions are descriptive, not causal mediation or fresh strength evidence.
